title: Dress up any avatar in Unreal Engine with LiveSync
content:
YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UcB1yAiFN8w?si=U46PXMsuyX-mXy1H

🌟 3 Key Reasons to Watch Our Latest Tutorial:[  
  
1️⃣](https://lnkd.in/drhXAUqb￼￼1️⃣) For the 3D Design Community: This tutorial is crafted for designers looking to push boundaries in digital fashion and animation.  
  
2️⃣ A Clear and Efficient Workflow: Discover how to dress your avatar in Unreal Engine using CLO or Marvelous with CONNECT’s Live Sync, explained step by step.  
  
3️⃣ Inspiring Innovation Together: We’re thrilled to kick off the year by sharing knowledge and fostering creativity within our community.  
  
📽️ If you’re passionate about 3D design and digital fashion, this tutorial is a must-watch. Let’s continue shaping the future of fashion together!

title: Calling All Creators: Join Our EveryWear Specialist Program
content:

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/e0eaa3bb49bd4e56af9575d46effcf31/images/7955aa80d17a4283be6e0c725a0efecc4658f223db5c4a3091c64d6a5e13af25.png)![acff62dacee84bf6b7e4e61ce1b60376](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/e0eaa3bb49bd4e56af9575d46effcf31/images/acff62dacee84bf6b7e4e61ce1b60376b6b5d935482d48ae89edb012fbd540b5.jpg)

**Dear Valued Users,**

**We are thrilled to announce the launch of our brand-new community, designed specifically for you!**

This exciting new space is where creativity meets collaboration,

allowing you to connect with fellow creators from all CLO Virtual Fashion platforms.

In this vibrant community, you will have the opportunity to share your ideas, learn from others, and inspire one another.

Whether you are a seasoned professional or just starting your journey in the 3D industry,

this is the perfect place to engage with like-minded individuals who share your passion for innovation and creativity.

# **What can you expect from our new community?**

**Connect** :

Network with other creators, share your experiences, and build lasting relationships within the CLO Virtual Fashion ecosystem.

**Create** :

Collaborate on projects, exchange feedback, and explore new ideas that can elevate your work to the next level.

**Learn** :

Access valuable resources, participate in discussions, and gain insights from industry experts and peers alike.

We believe that together, we can unlock endless opportunities for growth and creativity.

So, don't miss out on this chance to be part of something special!

Start Connecting and Collaborating Today!

# [[Join Now]](https://connect.clo-set.com/community)

We can't wait to see you there and witness the amazing things you will create together!

Best regards,

The CLO Virtual Fashion Team
content_description: Join the CLO Virtual Fashion community to connect, collaborate, and grow with fellow creators in a vibrant space dedicated to innovation and creativity.
